description: Live RAM-pressure monitor + Claude-session dashboard + crash-recovery. Keeps many Claude Code sessions from surprising you with an OOM.
config.warnThresholdPct: System RAM-used percent at which the status bar turns a warning color.
config.criticalThresholdPct: System RAM-used percent at which the status bar turns an error color and a pressure alert fires.
config.pollSeconds: How often (seconds) to refresh RAM + session stats.
